svg.title: Leaders of West African resistance to colonial rule
svg.desc: Map of West Africa marking leaders of resistance to European colonial rule: Lat Dior of Cayor in Senegal (killed 1886); Samori Toure of the Mandinka empire (resisted the French until 1898); Bai Bureh in Sierra Leone (Hut Tax War, 1898); Yaa Asantewaa of Asante (1900); Behanzin of Dahomey (1892–94); Sultan Attahiru I of Sokoto (1903); Jaja of Opobo (deported 1887); and Nana Olomu of the Itsekiri (1894).
